# Encounters Again and Again

> Art, ocean, education and conservation: expeditions, workshops for children, art and messages from a collective of ocean lovers.

Planned canonical origin: https://encountersagainandagain.com

## Sections

- [Home](/): the collective, what is coming and what happened
- [Encounters expeditions](/expeditions): ocean expeditions and their results
- [Artsy Animals workshops](/workshops): art workshops about ocean life
- [Art](/art): artworks by the crew, by category
- [Meaningful Messages](/meaningful-messages): messages and poems for the ocean
- [About us](/about): who we are and why
- [The crew](/crew): the people behind the project
- [Contact](/contact): how to reach the collective
